data.one_liner: Annotations for reactive_forms_generator to generate form models
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations that the reactive_forms_generator uses to create form model classes. It enables type-safe form handling and validation in Flutter apps.
use_when: You need strongly typed form models generated from annotations
You want to avoid writing boilerplate form code manually
You are already using reactive_forms and want code generation support
avoid_when: You are not using reactive_forms or its generator
strengths: Reduces boilerplate for form fields and validation
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation setup
data.setup_notes: Add dev_dependencies: build_runner, reactive_forms_generator; run flutter pub run build_runner build
